definitions.explanation: A substance that causes illness, injury, or death when ingested or absorbed; also includes animal venom.
Figuratively, something that has a harmful or corrupting influence.

examples.japanese: この{蛇|へび}には{毒|どく}がある。
{毒|どく}キノコを{食|た}べてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally ate a poisonous mushroom.

examples.japanese: {甘|あま}い{物|もの}は{食|た}べすぎると{体|からだ}に{毒|どく}だ。
examples.english: Too many sweets are bad for your health.

examples.japanese: {毒|どく}にも{薬|くすり}にもならない。
examples.notes: Set expression meaning something is completely ineffective

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {毒|どく}を{盛|も}る (to poison)
- {毒|どく}がある (to be poisonous/venomous)
- {毒|どく}を{吐|は}く (to speak venomously, to badmouth)
- {毒|どく}キノコ (poisonous mushroom)
- {毒|どく}{蛇|へび} (venomous snake)

COMPOUNDS:
- {毒薬|どくやく} (poison, toxic substance)
- {解毒|げどく} (detoxification)
- {中毒|ちゅうどく} (poisoning, addiction)
- {毒性|どくせい} (toxicity)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {毒|どく}にも{薬|くすり}にもならない (neither harmful nor helpful - useless)
- {毒|どく}を{食|く}らわば{皿|さら}まで (in for a penny, in for a pound)
